'''Feena''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Feena system/Legends|Feena system]]. It was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Feena lay between the [[B'trilla system/Legends|B'trilla]] and [[Kalishik system/Legends|Kalishik systems]] on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ardan Cross]]&mdash;a portion of which already linked it to the [[Arda system/Legends|Ethain]] and [[Troos system/Legends|Vynx systems]] by [[25,126 BBY]]&mdash;while the [[Feena Run]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route connected the world to the [[Barison system/Legends|Barison system]].<ref name="TEA" />

A [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] world that served as a major commercial hub of the Back Reach, Feena attracted merchants from along the lengths of the Ardan Cross and the Feena Run. Between 25,126 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and [[25,116 BBY]], Feena was known as '''Olgabl''' and formed a part of the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Feena was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-5.<ref name="TEA" />
